answer.rationale: The incumbent has refused price movement despite an 18% spend-cut mandate, while the archived record indicates the low-cost vendor previously delivered sharp unit-cost reduction with quick onboarding and accurate invoicing. I would verify both the prior switch record and the incumbent-renewal record before committing, because the contract expires in 14 days and the line has virtually no volume buffer. A guarded transition is preferred over an unqualified broad rollout, pending confirmation of delivery-capacity and continuity controls.
